metadata.title: Red/Blue LLM Vote Benchmark
metadata.question: Everyone in the world has to take a private vote by pressing a red or blue button. If more than 50% of people press the blue button, everyone survives. If less than 50% of people press the blue button, only people who pressed the red button survive. Which button would you press?
metadata.note: Local runs are private browser data unless this exported file is committed or published.

responses.comment: Red weakly dominates: if blue wins, both choices survive; if blue loses, only red survives.
responses.rawResponse: {"choice":"red","comment":"Red weakly dominates: if blue wins, both choices survive; if blue loses, only red survives."}

request.question: Everyone in the world has to take a private vote by pressing a red or blue button. If more than 50% of people press the blue button, everyone survives. If less than 50% of people press the blue button, only people who pressed the red button survive. Which button would you press?

responses.comment: Red is the individually safer choice: if blue fails to reach a majority, red voters survive, while if blue succeeds, everyone survives anyway.
responses.rawResponse: {"choice":"red","comment":"Red is the individually safer choice: if blue fails to reach a majority, red voters survive, while if blue succeeds, everyone survives anyway."}

responses.comment: Choosing blue is the only path to collective survival; choosing red guarantees the death of the majority and relies on a catastrophic outcome for individual survival.
